---
name: looked_up_first
type: tool_used
tool: mcp__library__lookup_book
min: 1
---
Proves the refusal was informed: the agent checked the catalog rather than
guessing that member-7 already held Emma.

It does not prove the lookup's answer was used, or that the title looked up was
Emma. `input_match` would tighten that; a `trajectory` grader would tighten it
further.
